notes: Emsisoft deploy: policy templates and a Home default. (1) New Settings option 'Default policy template' — pick your Residential customers policy (loads from your Emsisoft account once your key is saved) and it's applied automatically to each new deployment; the result screen shows which policy was applied. (2) Trial now defaults to Anti-Malware (Home) instead of Business. You can still change both per deploy and in Settings > Deploy defaults.
